sessions.title: Opening: patch the conference experience
sessions.abstract: Kickoff, rules and the problem statement: conferences are broken for attendees. Build something that fixes it.

sessions.title: Graph databases for AI apps: a FalkorDB primer
sessions.abstract: Model entities and relationships as a graph, query with Cypher, and add vector search to the same store.

sessions.title: GraphRAG for agent memory
sessions.abstract: Give agents long-term memory as a knowledge graph. Store tool calls and observations as edges, retrieve paths instead of chunks, and query why an agent took a step.

sessions.title: Evaluating agents before they ship
sessions.abstract: Offline evals, golden traces and regression suites for multi-step LLM agents.

sessions.title: AI code review that catches agent bugs
sessions.abstract: Context-aware review of agent code: tool schemas, retries and prompt changes, flagged in the pull request.

sessions.title: Tracing multi-agent systems end to end
sessions.abstract: Every tool call and model step as a span. Find the failing step in a multi-agent run, replay it, and alert on it in production.

sessions.title: Deploying LLM agents on Kubernetes
sessions.abstract: Ship agents and model servers to Kubernetes with autoscaling, secrets and rollbacks, using TrueFoundry.

sessions.title: Live web data for agents
sessions.abstract: Unblock any public page, get it as markdown, and feed agents fresh web data with Bright Data.

sessions.title: OpenTelemetry for LLM apps
sessions.abstract: Semantic conventions for LLM spans, token and cost metrics, and where vendor tracers plug in.

sessions.title: Running inference at scale
sessions.abstract: Batching, caching and GPU utilisation for serving models and agent workloads at scale.

sessions.title: GPU scheduling for inference workloads
sessions.abstract: Bin-packing models onto GPUs, fractional GPUs and queue-based autoscaling on Kubernetes.

sessions.title: Panel: hiring for AI engineering teams
sessions.abstract: What teams building AI infrastructure look for in engineers, and how to get hired into one.

sessions.title: Hackathon demos and judging
sessions.abstract: Teams demo what they built. Judges from the sponsors pick winners per track.
